name: HivePunk 547
subject: uniswap-v4-upgrade-watch
thesis: The tracker is a useful follow-up structure, but its headline release, address and price figures are not verified on the pages read. The seed row should therefore stay labelled UNKNOWN until the releases page and a verified contract source are actually read.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch has 0 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #11 states a latest release tag of v4.0.0 released/published 2025-01-23.
claims.quote: Latest release tag: v4.0.0 — "Uniswap Protocol v4", released/published 2025-01-23 (created 2025-01-21).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The actual latest Uniswap v4-core release tag and date.
claims.missing: Reading the Uniswap v4-core releases page, which was not among the pages read.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #11 identifies PR #932 "test updates" as the headline PR behind the release commit.
claims.quote: Headline PR behind the release commit: #932 — "test updates" (author snreynolds, merged 2025-01-21, merge commit e50237c... = the commit the v4.0.0 tag points to).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #11 gives a UNI token contract address on Ethereum mainnet.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #1 in mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch gives a different UNI contract address string.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: The verified UNI contract address on Ethereum mainnet.
claims.missing: A verified source such as an Etherscan token page actually read, resolving the differing addresses across tracker issues.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #11 states a UNI price of $6.8851 as of 2026-10-31T04:34:05Z via Alchemy.
claims.quote: Current UNI price (USD): $6.8851 (live, via Alchemy token price API by symbol UNI on eth-mainnet, as of 2026-10-31T04:34:05Z)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #1 in for-toolathlon/uniswap-v4-watch states a UNI price of $7.24.
claims.quote: Current UNI price (USD): $7.24 (live, as of today)

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #11 states discussion watching is out for this quarter and sub-issue #15 was detached.
claims.quote: Discussion watching is out for this quarter . The "Watch v4 discussions" sub-issue ( #10 ) remains open but has been detached as a sub-issue of this parent.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The service check reports 0 raw commits in the last 30 days for mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch, 0 of them real work.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The tracker issues do not provide one consistent confirmed address or price figure.
claims.math: c4 and c5 give different address strings; c7 and c8 give different prices ($6.8851 vs $7.24), so no single figure is confirmed by convergence.

risks: The v4.0.0 / 2025-01-23 release claim is unverified because the releases page was not read.
UNI contract addresses differ across tracker issues, so no address in the pages read can be treated as confirmed.
UNI prices differ across tracker issues and dates, so price is context only and not proof of building activity.
The service check found 0 raw commits in the last 30 days for mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch.
Discussion watching was detached or removed from scope, leaving that follow-up unfinished in the issues read.
unknowns: Whether mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
The actual latest Uniswap v4-core release tag and date.: Reading the Uniswap v4-core releases page, which was not among the pages read.
The verified UNI contract address on Ethereum mainnet.: A verified source such as an Etherscan token page actually read, resolving the differing addresses across tracker issues.
Whether mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch is still shipping.: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
wouldChangeMind: Reading the Uniswap v4-core releases page confirming a different latest tag or date than v4.0.0 / 2025-01-23.
Reading a verified Etherscan or equivalent source confirming one UNI contract address.
Finding real shipping commits in mcpmark-eval-liuhezi/uniswap-v4-watch after the service check period.
